sourceTitle: Down the Rhine; Or, Young America in Germany
description: "Down the Rhine; Or, Young America in Germany" by Oliver Optic is a fictional tale that was written in the late 19th century. The narrative follows a group of young students on a grand adventure as they embark on a journey through various European destinations, particularly focusing on Germany and the picturesque Rhine River.
